input_parameters.title: RetrievePageOfCompaniesRequest

after.title: After
after.description: Pagination token from `paging.next.after` of a previous response, used to fetch the subsequent page. Omit for the first page.
after.human_parameter_description: The token from the previous page to continue where you left off. Leave this blank to start from the first page.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of companies to return per page, controlling pagination size (default: 10).
limit.human_parameter_description: How many companies to show per page. Choose a smaller number for quick previews or a larger one to see more results at once (up to 100).

archived.title: Archived
archived.description: Boolean flag to filter companies by archived status: `true` returns only archived companies; `false` (default) returns only active companies.
archived.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to see archived companies instead of active ones. Turn this on to retrieve only companies that have been archived.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: List of company property internal names to include in the response (e.g., 'name', 'domain'). If omitted, a default set of properties is returned.
properties.human_parameter_description: Which company details you want returned, like name or domain. Pick only what you need to keep the results clean and fast.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: List of object types (e.g., 'contacts', 'deals') for which to retrieve associated IDs with each company.
associations.human_parameter_description: Related records you want included with each company, such as contacts or deals. This helps you see linked items without making extra requests.

propertiesWithHistory.title: Properties With History
propertiesWithHistory.description: List of property internal names for which to retrieve historical values (e.g., 'industry'). If no history exists for a property, only its current value is returned.
propertiesWithHistory.human_parameter_description: Properties you want with their past values, not just the current one. Useful when you care about how a field has changed over time.
